caption:
Can you explain your answer out loud?

Say what the question asks, how you got the answer, and why each wrong choice fails. If you can't, you've found what to study next.

Send this to your study partner.
tiktok_caption: Got it right? Now explain it out loud. That's the real check.

youtube.title: SAT Study Tip: Explain Your Answer Out Loud
youtube.description: After each SAT practice question, explain out loud what it asks, how you solved it, and why the other choices are wrong to find hidden gaps.
